annotations.title: Rank a recon'd stack into a dig order

description:
Turn a recon'd stack into a ranked dig-order for authorized bug-hunting.

For each discovered component, returns its top high-risk CVEs (KEV / CISA-SSVC-
active / high-EPSS first) AND its `recurring_loci` — the bug classes (CWE) this
product family repeatedly fails at, ranked by real in-the-wild exploitation —
i.e. WHERE to look first and WHAT shape to expect. Components are ordered by
their most-exploitable bug (`dig_rank`). Grounded in exploitation data, not model
guesses; lays out facts for triage/where-to-look, never a payload.

Banners go in verbatim ("OpenSSH_9.2p1 Debian-2+deb12u3", "Apache/2.4.62 (Debian)"):
a Debian/Ubuntu/Alpine build adds `distro_fix`, and CVEs the distro already fixed in that
build rank below the rest.

Args:
    technologies: discovered stack, e.g. ["craftcms 4.4", "nginx", "keycloak"].
    per_tech: how many top CVEs to surface per component (default 4).
name: hunt_plan
title: Rank a recon'd stack into a dig order
